title: plotit
text: plotit 是一个基于 ggplot2 的声明式、管道优先 R 绘图包。它用统一的动词前缀 API 替代了基于 + 的图层叠加，支持原生管道 （|>）。合理的默认设置消除了样板代码——颜色、主题和尺寸开箱即用。
code: library(plotit)  iris |>   plotit(encode(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, colour = Species)) |>   mark_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) |>   scale_color(range = "viridis") |>   label_title("Iris Sepal Dimensions") |>   style(base_theme = ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) |>   export("iris_plot.pdf")

title: Advanced Plotting
text: compose_*() assembles independent plots (different data, geometries, scales). split_*() facets one dataset. composers return plotit_composite continues label_*(), style(), export().
code: p1 <- iris |>   plotit(encode(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, colour = Species)) |>   mark_point(alpha = 0.6) p2 <- iris |>   plotit(encode(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) |>   mark_boxplot() compose_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 2, tag_levels = "A") |>   label_title("Iris dashboard") main <- iris |>   plotit(encode(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, colour = Species)) |>   mark_point() top <- iris |>   plotit(encode(x = Sepal.Width, fill = Species)) |>   mark_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.5) right <- iris |>   plotit(encode(x = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) |>   mark_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.5) |>   project_cartesian(flip = TRUE) compose_marginal(main, top, right) compose_inset(p1, p2, left = 0.6, bottom = 0.6, right = 0.95, top = 0.95)

title: Advanced Plotting
text: layout data transform, layer. as_graph() normalises relations plotit_graph; layout_*() bakes coordinates tables; marks render sub-tables data = ~table.    Relational sugar marks (mark_sankey, mark_treemap, mark_network, mark_chord) call engines. Prefer sugar one-liners; drop layout_* need custom marks sub-tables.
code: edges / matrix / tree ──as_graph()──▶ plotit_graph ──layout_*()──▶ x/y columns                                               │                     plotit(graph) ──▶ mark_*(data = ~nodes | ~edges | ~ribbons) flows <- data.frame(   source = c("A", "A", "B", "B", "C"),   target = c("B", "C", "C", "D", "D"),   value = c(10, 5, 8, 3, 6) ) # Sugar path flows |>   plotit(encode(source = source, target = target, value = value, fill = source)) |>   mark_sankey() #> Coordinate system already present. #> ℹ Adding new coordinate system, which will replace the existing one. # Explicit layout path as_graph(flows) |>   plotit() |>   layout_sankey() |>   mark_polygon(data = ~ribbons) |>   mark_rect(data = ~nodes) edges <- data.frame(source = c("a", "a", "b", "c"), target = c("b", "c", "d", "d")) nodes <- data.frame(id = c("a", "b", "c", "d"), type = c("x", "y", "x", "y")) as_graph(edges, nodes = nodes) |>   plotit() |>   layout_force(seed = 4) |>   mark_rule(data = ~edges) |>   mark_point(data = ~nodes)

title: API
text: Every verb returns plotit (plotit_composite) object, native pipe |> composition operator. Single-plot verbs accept plotit_composite; build panels first, compose_*().
code: data |> plotit(encode(...)) |>   mark_*(...) |>   layout_*(...) |>               # relational graphs only   split_*(...) |>   project_*(...) |>   scale_*(...) |>   label_*(...) |>   style(...) |>   export(...)

title: API
text: width/height panel sizes (WYSIWYG baked plot). Without colour/fill mapping, default_color injects single hue channels; colour/fill scale clears automatically.
code: plotit(data, mapping = encode(), autofit = FALSE,        width = 5, height = 3.5, size_unit = "in",        dodge = NULL, default_color = "#0072B2")  encode(...)                 # forwarded to aes(); returns plotit_encode add_ggplot(plot, gg_obj)    # append any ggplot2 layer, keep the pipe

title: API
text: Shared signature standard marks: Three tiers: Named parameters worth knowing: mark_step(direction=), mark_rug(sides=), mark_curve(curvature=), mark_text(repel=), mark_errorbar(stat=, level=), mark_heatmap(cluster=, scale=), mark_network(edge_shape=). Full lists live Reference.
code: mark_<type>(plot, mapping = NULL, data = NULL, position = NULL,             ..., rasterize = FALSE, rasterize_dpi = 300, rasterize_dev = "cairo")

title: API
text: Legal trans values filtered per aesthetic: identity / log / log10 / log2 / sqrt / reverse / discrete / binned. Colour/fill also accept na_color, n_bins, diverging mid anchor. Date/POSIXct columns auto-route date axis — force trans = "identity" .
code: scale_<aes>(plot, name = waiver(), trans = <default>, limits = NULL,             range = NULL, breaks = NULL, labels = NULL, ...)

title: API
text: layout data transform, layer: bakes coordinates @graph sub-tables (nodes, edges, ribbons, …). Marks render tables data = ~nodes / ~edges / ~ribbons. Sugar marks (mark_sankey, mark_treemap, mark_network, mark_chord) call engines — drop layout_* need custom marks sub-tables.
code: as_graph(data, source, target, value, nodes)  layout_force(plot, iterations, seed, weights)   # seed required layout_circle(plot, order_by) layout_tree(plot, direction, leaf_spacing, edge) layout_dendrogram(plot, direction) layout_chord(plot, inner_radius, pad_angle, curvature, order_by) layout_sankey(plot, node_width, padding, curvature, ...) layout_treemap(plot)
